Gravity-compensation model
==========================

Source repository: https://github.com/TomCC7/OpenYAM_description
Source commit: c24ef66cdcf87b9a767ec6ecd8ac8ae971bab2f7

Only the gravity-compensation URDF and its referenced mesh assets are retained
from OpenYAM_description. The upstream package.xml declares the Apache-2.0
license. The upstream repository does not provide a standalone LICENSE file,
so none is fabricated in this redistribution.

The obsolete OpenYAM_description visualization and planning models are
intentionally excluded. Hardware gravity compensation continues to use
urdf/yam_gripper_gravity.urdf.

Canonical visualization/planning model
========================================

Source repository: https://github.com/i2rt-robotics/i2rt
Source commit: 5d47b358bafb30c65e397f2ece506550a0db4594
Source path: i2rt/robot_models/arm/yam

The upstream yam.urdf and assets directory are redistributed under i2rt/. Mesh
references are rewritten from relative paths to package://yam_description URIs
for DimOS resolution; geometry, transforms, joints, and mesh data are
unchanged. DimOS uses this as the sole visualization and planning model.
